messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable multiplayer-inspired “Blox fruits” game in the existing repository.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport at most 1280px wide) for visual checks and inspect only the latest.

## Decisions
- Built an original browser game called **Fruitbound**, themed around island exploration, bandit combat, and Gum-Gum fruit abilities.
- Added local browser-tab multiplayer presence using `BroadcastChannel`; implementation is incomplete.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a responsive game UI with player stats, quest progress, crew, hotbar, map overlay, and mobile touch controls.
- Implemented canvas island gameplay with movement, combat, abilities, enemies, crew NPC behavior, XP/leveling, rewards, and sound toggle.
- `node --check game.js` passed.
- Rendered and inspected `/tmp/opencode/fruitbound.png` in Chromium.

### Active
- Finish the multiplayer presence implementation in `game.js` and ensure peers are rendered and updated.
- Run a browser check after multiplayer changes.

### Blocked
- Browser capture via `playwright-cli` failed because its Chromium install was missing: `Browser "chromium" is not installed`.
- Screenshot conversion to JPEG was unavailable (`convert` missing; Python PIL missing).

## Next Move
1. Inspect `game.js` around `localId`, `peers`, `channel`, and `tick()`; finish broadcasting player position/state and rendering remote players.
2. Run `node --check game.js`, then test using installed `/usr/bin/chromium` and save a JPEG if a converter is available.
3. Review the rendered result and report the single-tab multiplayer limitation honestly.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI structure and controls.
- `style.css`: Responsive game interface and overlays.
- `game.js`: Canvas game, gameplay logic, and in-progress multiplayer presence.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Multiplayer was requested; the current code only initializes a `BroadcastChannel` and records received peer messages. No player state is broadcast yet, and peers are not drawn.
- A Chromium screenshot exists at `/tmp/opencode/fruitbound.png`; it was read and appeared to show the game.
